    What are Intermediates?

    Intermediate Dyes comprise petroleum downstream products that are further processed for transformation to finished dyes and pigments

    Intermediates are specially used for manufacturing of several Acid dyes, Solvent dyes, Pigments, and also as intermediates in some Agro and Pharma Industries.

    Features ?

    • Among the main application of these dye intermediates is in hair dyes.
    • Some popular dye intermediates comprise acid orange, yellow and acid black dyes, basic magenta lumps, malachite green crystal and others.
